definition: Large Language and Speech Model — a model combining a language model with speech input so it can understand and respond to spoken queries.
details: Large Language and Speech Model — a model combining a language model with speech input so it can understand and respond to spoken queries.

explainer.lead: LLaSM is a Large Language and Speech Model that combines a language model with speech input so it can understand and respond to spoken queries. It matters because it extends LLM interaction beyond text to voice.

tiers.eli5: It's an AI that can listen to you speak and answer, instead of only reading typed text.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use LLaSM to build voice-driven assistants where spoken queries are understood by the combined speech and language model. A pitfall is that speech input introduces recognition errors that can propagate into the model's responses.
tiers.paperLevel: LLaSM is defined as a Large Language and Speech Model: a model combining a language model with speech input so it can understand and respond to spoken queries. No formal formula or quantified limits are given.

explainer.example: A user asks a question out loud, and LLaSM processes the speech and returns a spoken-query answer.
